name: Invisibility, Superior
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level psychic 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

DESCRIPTION

This spells acts as greater invisibility except that you create no sound, footprints and have no smell unless you wish to. Additionally, your invisibility is not thwarted by spells like invisibility purge, glitterdust, or faerie fire or the blindsense ability.

However, creatures affected by true seeing or blindsight can still detect the subject of the spell.
